feeds.title: iLLANOiZE
feeds.description: Our website shares articles related to Hip-hop and R&B Music, interviews, podcast, sports, and fashion. iLLANOiZE was founded in 2012. Our focus is press and media coverage, broadcasting, podcasting, marketing, promotion, website design, app development, distribution, and more.

feeds.title: Kollege Kidd
feeds.description: Our website is focused on the Chicago Hip Hop scene and Chicago life as a whole, look here for new music as well as scenes from the underground that won't make the news. Kollege Kidd is the Leader of the new Skool and the source for the Kulture.

feeds.title: Chicago Bangerz Blog
feeds.description: Chi Bangerz is the #1 Chicago-based music blog covering what's bangin! We are given the mission of empowering local artists & events while still covering mainstream news and bringing America 1 step closer to you. Chicago Bangerz is a part of The United States Blog Network, which is a collection of tastemakers from all over the map consolidating efforts to showcase the elite artists in the country.

feeds.title: The Hype Magazine » Chicago-artist
feeds.description: This section of our blog shares news about Chicago Hip Hop. Hi, I'm Dr.Jameelah the Chairman of The Hype Magazine. We service our readers with a diverse collection of stories, interviews, and impactful editorials. Our audience range includes fashion fans; gamers; movie nuts; MMA followers; EDM; rock, television personalities, and more if it's newsworthy we cover it.

feeds.title: Hip Hop Scriptures Blog
feeds.description: Our blog shares articles on the latest news and updates about the hip-hop world. Hop Scriptures is a digital, interactive, virtual hip-hop museum. An ode to hip-hop - its birth and evolution is a time capsule a gift to the Universe and an effort of love.
